custom_button = {
	name = DA_Legendary_Encounter_Province_Button
	tooltip = DA_Legendary_Encounter_Province_Button_tt
	potential = {
		owned_by = FROM
		DA_LE_province_has_legend = yes
	}
	trigger = { owned_by = FROM }
	effect = {
		FROM = {
			clr_country_flag = DA_province_mega_engineering_open
			clr_country_flag = DA_province_medicine_open
			clr_country_flag = DA_province_fortifications_open
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_province_flag = DA_LE_open }
			clr_province_flag = DA_LE_open
		}
		else = {
			set_province_flag = DA_LE_open
			hidden_effect = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						NOT = { has_province_flag = DA_LE_seen }
						DA_LE_ruler_can_lead = yes
					}
					set_province_flag = DA_LE_ruler_leads
				}
				set_province_flag = DA_LE_seen
				DA_LE_refresh = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

custom_button = {
	name = DA_LE_contain
	tooltip = DA_LE_contain_tt
	potential = { NOT = { has_province_flag = DA_LE_engaged } }
	trigger = {
		owned_by = FROM
		custom_trigger_tooltip = { tooltip = DA_LE_unlocked_tt DA_LE_unlocked = yes }
		custom_trigger_tooltip = { tooltip = DA_LE_can_be_contained_tt DA_LE_can_be_contained = yes }
		custom_trigger_tooltip = { tooltip = DA_LE_not_contained_tt NOT = { DA_LE_contained = yes } }
		if = {
			limit = { DA_LE_is_lich = yes check_variable = { which = DA_LE_contain_n value = 0 } NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_LE_contain_n value = 1 } } }
			owner = { treasury = 400 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { DA_LE_is_lich = yes check_variable = { which = DA_LE_contain_n value = 1 } NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_LE_contain_n value = 2 } } }
			owner = { treasury = 600 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { DA_LE_is_lich = yes check_variable = { which = DA_LE_contain_n value = 2 } NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_LE_contain_n value = 3 } } }
			owner = { treasury = 800 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { DA_LE_is_lich = yes check_variable = { which = DA_LE_contain_n value = 3 } }
			owner = { treasury = 1000 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { DA_LE_is_dragon = yes check_variable = { which = DA_LE_contain_n value = 0 } NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_LE_contain_n value = 1 } } }
			owner = { treasury = 500 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { DA_LE_is_dragon = yes check_variable = { which = DA_LE_contain_n value = 1 } NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_LE_contain_n value = 2 } } }
			owner = { treasury = 750 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { DA_LE_is_dragon = yes check_variable = { which = DA_LE_contain_n value = 2 } NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_LE_contain_n value = 3 } } }
			owner = { treasury = 1000 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { DA_LE_is_dragon = yes check_variable = { which = DA_LE_contain_n value = 3 } }
			owner = { treasury = 1500 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { DA_LE_is_maze_guest = yes check_variable = { which = DA_LE_contain_n value = 0 } NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_LE_contain_n value = 1 } } }
			owner = { treasury = 300 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { DA_LE_is_maze_guest = yes check_variable = { which = DA_LE_contain_n value = 1 } NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_LE_contain_n value = 2 } } }
			owner = { treasury = 450 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { DA_LE_is_maze_guest = yes check_variable = { which = DA_LE_contain_n value = 2 } NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_LE_contain_n value = 3 } } }
			owner = { treasury = 600 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { DA_LE_is_maze_guest = yes check_variable = { which = DA_LE_contain_n value = 3 } }
			owner = { treasury = 800 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { DA_LE_is_dream = yes check_variable = { which = DA_LE_contain_n value = 0 } NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_LE_contain_n value = 1 } } }
			owner = { treasury = 200 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { DA_LE_is_dream = yes check_variable = { which = DA_LE_contain_n value = 1 } NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_LE_contain_n value = 2 } } }
			owner = { treasury = 300 }

custom_button = {
	name = DA_LE_parley
	tooltip = DA_LE_parley_tt
	potential = { NOT = { has_province_flag = DA_LE_engaged } }
	trigger = {
		owned_by = FROM
		custom_trigger_tooltip = { tooltip = DA_LE_unlocked_tt DA_LE_unlocked = yes }
		custom_trigger_tooltip = { tooltip = DA_LE_parley_refused_tt NOT = { OR = { DA_LE_is_lich = yes DA_LE_is_dragon = yes } } }
	}
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { DA_LE_is_hunter = yes }
			owner = { country_event = { id = DA_Hold_Gor_Vazumbrog.50 } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { DA_LE_is_gatewarden = yes }
			owner = { country_event = { id = DA_Remaining_Holds_event.10 } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { DA_LE_is_maze_guest = yes }
			owner = { country_event = { id = DA_Remaining_Holds_event.20 } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { DA_LE_is_ombrindal = yes }
			owner = { country_event = { id = DA_Remaining_Holds_event.30 } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { DA_LE_is_dream = yes }
			owner = { country_event = { id = DA_Remaining_Wonders_event.240 } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { DA_LE_is_guest = yes }
			owner = { country_event = { id = DA_Dur_Vazhatun_event.50 } }
		}
	}
}

		custom_trigger_tooltip = { tooltip = DA_LE_not_regrouping_tt NOT = { has_province_modifier = DA_LE_regroup } }

			tooltip = DA_LE_someone_fights_tt
			OR = { has_province_flag = DA_LE_ruler_leads num_of_units_in_province = { who = FROM amount = 1 } }
		}
	}
	effect = { hidden_effect = { DA_LE_engage = yes } }

		clr_province_flag = DA_LE_sel_transmutation
		if = {
			limit = { has_province_flag = DA_LE_sel_conjuration }
			clr_province_flag = DA_LE_sel_conjuration
		}
		else = {
			set_province_flag = DA_LE_sel_conjuration
		}
	}
	frame = { number = 2 trigger = { has_province_flag = DA_LE_sel_conjuration } }
	frame = { number = 3 trigger = { has_province_flag = DA_LE_cd_conjuration } }
	frame = { number = 1 trigger = { DA_LE_school_ready = { school = conjuration } } }
	frame = { number = 4 trigger = { always = yes } }
}
